essence: Such negative qualities characterize a practitioner unfit for mantra success.
Even vast repetition does not produce mantra success for such a practitioner.
The initial consecrations are birth, vivification, striking, and awakening in order.
Satiation, illumination, and protection are further consecrations in the sequence.
Through the ten consecrations, mantras come to full manifestation.
